notes: Copilot adapter: single source of truth for which model each agent profile in .github/agents/ is pinned to.
Edit this file, then run scripts/sync-agent-models.ps1 to rewrite the 'model:' line in each profile. Never hand-edit a 'model:' line.
Model names must match the Copilot model picker exactly, in the qualified form 'Model Name (copilot)'.
For Heavy changes, use the reviewer profile from the model family opposite the implementer: Reviewer-GPT after Claude-family edits and Reviewer-Claude after GPT-family edits.
A tier lists models in priority order; keep fallbacks inside the same family so cross-family review is preserved.

Only GPT and Claude families are used in this Copilot mapping. No Strong tier exists yet; Strong tasks use the best available models. Add family-specific Strong tiers when larger models become available.
Re-verify against the model picker when models or account access change, or after staleAfterDays.
source: VS Code Copilot Chat model picker, as listed by the repository owner on verifiedOn
